lean.statement:
theorem interpolationDerivative_lower_bound_of_expandedBakryEmery
    (generator : (X → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℝ))
    {alpha : ℝ} (_halpha : 0 < alpha)
    (hcurvature : ∀ (g : X → ℝ) (y : X),
      alpha * carreDuChamp generator g g y ≤
        (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          (generator (carreDuChamp generator g g) y -
            carreDuChamp generator g (generator g) y -
            carreDuChamp generator g (generator g) y))
    (f : X → ℝ) (x : X) :
    2 * alpha * carreDuChamp generator f f x ≤
      generator (carreDuChamp generator f f) x -
        2 * carreDuChamp generator f (generator f) x
approved_definition_context: carreDuChamp generator f g denotes the same real-valued binary expression Γ_L(f,g) appearing in the source restatement.
The generator type explicitly makes it a real-linear map on all real-valued functions over an arbitrary type X.
